# Fekitech
> Business systems for profitable growth

Fekitech is a business transformation company that helps business owners build organised, profitable businesses with better systems, clearer operations, improved performance, and ongoing expert support.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://fekitech.co.uk/): Overview of Fekitech's business transformation solutions.
- [About](https://fekitech.co.uk/about): Learn how Fekitech helps businesses become organised, data-driven, profitable, and scalable.
- [Services](https://fekitech.co.uk/services): Business transformation services for improving operations, systems, profitability, and performance.
- [Pricing](https://fekitech.co.uk/pricing): Business transformation packages designed to help businesses improve systems and operations.
- [Blog](https://fekitech.co.uk/blog): Practical insights on business transformation, operations, profitability, and customer growth.
- [Contact](https://fekitech.co.uk/contact): Contact Fekitech for business transformation support and expert advisory.

## Services
- [Business Structure Design](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/business-structure-design): Define roles, responsibilities, workflows, ownership, and decision rhythms.
- [Digital Transformation](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/digital-transformation): Implement practical digital systems that reduce manual work.
- [Business Intelligence Architecture](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/business-intelligence-architecture): Design reporting systems, dashboards, and performance signals.
- [Process Optimisation and Automation](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/process-optimisation): Map, simplify, and automate repeated workflows.
- [Customer Retention Systems](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/customer-retention-systems): Improve follow-up, communication, and customer experience.
- [Profitability Improvement](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/profitability-improvement): Identify operational gaps, revenue leakage, and cost waste.
- [Company Customised AI Agents](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/ai-agents): Build AI agents tailored to your business.
- [Workflow Automations](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/workflow-automations): Design and implement automation systems.
- [Training & Development](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/training-development): Training programs to improve staff performance.
- [Software Development](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/software-development): Custom software and mobile/web applications.
- [Startup Mentorship](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/startup-mentorship): Guide startups with strategy and business growth support.
- [Career Development](https://fekitech.co.uk/services/career-development): Go from CV to job offer with a complete career system.

## Optional: Key facts
- Fekitech combines custom software, intelligent automation, and expert technology consultancy.
- Fekitech improves customer journeys with better follow-up, response systems, and retention processes.
- Fekitech streamlines operations with clear systems, ownership, and workflows.
- Fekitech identifies operational gaps, revenue leakage, cost waste, and margin pressure across the business.
